Name: Nyapu-style Portraits for Extras and Central Station
Author: toshamagna
Description:
This mod provides portraits for TDIT-Extras and TDIT-Central Station in Nyapu style. I began this project with the idea of keeping everything for personal use, but my dear friend pushed me to share it with the rest of the world. I hope you’ll appreciate my work!

To install the mod, simply download the file and extract the zip in your mod folder (Content Patcher is needed).

[b]Special thanks to:
[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu [/url]– for sharing their awesome art with everyone.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DolphinIsNotaFish]DolphinIsNotaFish [/url]– for creating TDIT, for giving me permission to work on their mods and for writing the code of this mod.
My friends – for putting up with me.

I wish you all a happy holiday season! Merry Christmas!
